title: The Ferryman's Tale
offer: Old Halvard told a story here last night: a hidden cove, where the swans of the lakes are born. He says: ask the potter, the miller and the old man of Svanetorp.

steps.say: The cove? My grandmother said: it lies where the reeds grow tallest. Ask Astrid.
Reeds? The tallest ones grow south, by Svanetorp. Go to Grim.
So you found my secret. Behind my farm, in the reeds: the swan cove. Look, the cygnets! Grey and fluffy. Tell no one!

reward.gift: the secret of the swan cove

fact: Young swans are grey, not white; they are called cygnets.
